request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: Finds SQLDatabase in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py, then its direct subclasses via class_bases. For each subclass in non-test files, it lists public methods (names not starting with underscore) defined in the class body that are not defined on SQLDatabase itself, using symbol_profile for the enclosing class field.
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND name = 'SQLDatabase' AND kind = 'class'), direct_children AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN base b ON cb.base_symbol_id = b.symbol_id), base_methods AS (SELECT sp.name FROM code.symbol_profile sp JOIN base b ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = b.symbol_id WHERE sp.is_method) SELECT DISTINCT sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, sp.name AS method_name FROM code.symbol_profile sp JOIN direct_children dc ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = dc.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON sp.file_id = f.file_id WHERE sp.is_method AND sp.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND sp.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM base_methods) ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name
